name: Kais Tannous
career: Accounts payable coordinator for a regional construction supplier
bio: Kais keeps a tight spreadsheet at work and is the guy coworkers ask when a vendor invoice has gone sideways. After hours, he unwinds with Zelda II runs on an old NES, quick boxing knockout clips, and stand-up bits that he forwards to his brothers. He tends a small backyard hive, dries goldenrod for homemade salves, and shares the house with a bossy gray cat while quietly donating to rescue-dog groups without liking dramatic rescue-story posts. On weekends he sometimes plays darbuka at family parties, then comes home to make chicken spaghetti and fuss over whether the porch pumpkins are lined up evenly.
